mapper.sql: id, bill_no, bill_name, status, created_by, creator, created_at, updated_by, updator, updated_at, processed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipping_mark_import (bill_no, bill_name, status, created_by, creator, created_at, updated_by, updator, updated_at, processed_at) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{billName}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{creator}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updator}, #{updatedAt}, #{processedAt})
